blocks.text: Polymorphism (kai shaklein) ka matlab hai ke alag alag objects ek hi method ya function call ka jawab apne apne tareeqe se dete hain. Ek hi interface (bulane ka tareeqa) ek jaise kaamon ke liye istemal hota hai, magar asal kaam har object ke mutabiq hota hai.
Yeh tab faida mand hai jab alag alag classes ek method ko alag tareeqe se likhein aur hum sab ko ek hi tarah bulana chahein.

def animal_sound(animal):
    animal.make_sound( )
dog = Dog( )
cat = Cat( )
animal_sound(dog)  # Output: Bark!
animal_sound(cat)   # Output: Meow!

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab calls mein anima1_sound (L ki jagah 1) chhapti hai, jabke function ka naam animal_sound hai; NameError aata hai. dog = Dog( ) se neeche ki lines bhi aadhi khiski hui chhapi hain (IndentationError); yeh margin se shuru hoti hain.

Wazahat: yeh code 2.8.1.5 wali Animal, Dog aur Cat classes ke saath chalta hai. animal_sound() Dog aur Cat dono ko ek tarah sambhalta hai: animal_sound(dog) "Bark!" aur animal_sound(cat) "Meow ! " print karta hai.

blocks.prompt: animal_sound() polymorphism ki misal kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Ek hi call, animal.make_sound(), object ki class ke mutabiq alag result deti hai, is liye function Dog aur Cat dono ko ek hi tareeqe se sambhalta hai.

blocks.text: Ek hi function animal_sound() har object ke liye apna jawab deta hai. animals ki list mein "dog", "cat" ya koi aur naam (maslan "cow") likh kar Run karein.

items: Polymorphism: ek call, har object ka apna jawab (Bark!, Meow !).
